Card Q&A.a: Cards that meet all of the conditions below and have unique card numbers can be placed in this card’s Digivolution cards with this card's [On Play] effect.-The cards must be in your hand or trash.-The cards must have [Cyborg] in their traits.-The cards must be red or black Digimon cards.-The cards must be level 5 Digimon cards.
Card Q&A.q: Can you explain in detail which cards I can place in this card’s digivolution cards with this card’s [On Play] effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes. The effect reads, “You may trash,” so you can choose not to trash any cards.
Card Q&A.q: When this card is deleted, can I choose not to trash 2 of its digivolution cards?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. For example, if your opponent activates an "if your opponent has as many or more total Digimon and Tamers as you, delete 1 of your opponent's highest level Digimon. Then, delete 1 of your opponent’s lowest level Digimon" effect, you can activate this card's "when [...] would be deleted" effect for the 1st deletion, then you can activate this card's "when [...] would be deleted" effect for the 2nd deletion that was activated by your opponent.
Card Q&A.q: If a single effect would delete multiple Digimon, can I activate this card's "when [...] would be deleted" effect for each deletion?

Effect: [On Play] By placing up to 5 level 5 black and/or red cards with [Cyborg] in their traits and different card numbers from your hand and/or trash in this Digimon's digivolution cards, gain 1 memory for each card placed.
[All Turns] This Digimon's DP can't be reduced.
[All Turns] When this Digimon would be deleted, by trashing 2 level 5 Digimon cards in this Digimon's digivolution cards, prevent that deletion.
